protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: DefaultConfig supplied TlsInsecureSkipVerify=true to new configurations and as the base before JSON unmarshal, while shared outbound clients copied the value into tls.Config.InsecureSkipVerify. At v3.56.0 this disables certificate validation and permits a network MitM to intercept or modify storage traffic. The live CVE.org record for CVE-2026-25160 was independently checked on 2026-08-29 and remains PUBLISHED; the frozen GHSA has withdrawn_at=null.

The earlier field introduction 7bc46de8aabc5d40d7fae04689725201685d4241 used the secure false default, so it is not the BIC. Reverse pickaxe and blame at v3.56.0 and the fix first parent identify c8f3e8ab as the surviving first-write.
